keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «배가 바위에 부딪쳐 물이 들어오기 시작했다(문제)» 와 «소민이가 침착했기 때문에 모두가 탈출할 수 있었다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the ship hit a rock and water started coming in) and the solution (Somin stayed calm and helped everyone escape). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Somin, her dad, the people on the ferry
The ferry hit a rock and started to sink.
Somin stayed calm and found the way out.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: Somin and her dad were on a ferry to a small island.
a boat that carries people across water
to get out of a dangerous place
Somin could not see the exit anywhere!
the way out of a place
help that saves people from danger

qs.q: Why did water start coming into the ship?
qs.qko: 배 안으로 왜 물이 들어오기 시작했나요?
opts: A big wave broke a window.
evs: Somin and her dad were on a ferry to a small island.
The ship had hit a rock, and water started coming in.
Somin found the life jackets under the seats and helped a little boy put one on.
Everyone followed her up the stairs to the deck.
why: 본문에 «배가 바위에 부딪쳤고, 물이 들어오기 시작했다»라고 나와요. 큰 파도가 창문을 깼다거나 소민이가 문을 열었다는 말은 없어요.
The text says the ship had hit a rock, and water started coming in. Nothing says a wave broke a window or that Somin opened a door.

qs.q: Dad says, "Stay calm and remember the safety video." What does "stay calm" mean here?
qs.qko: 아빠가 "Stay calm and remember the safety video."라고 말해요. 여기서 "stay calm"은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: do not panic and think clearly
stay in your seat and sleep
evs: People screamed and ran in every direction.
Suddenly, there was a loud CRASH, and the ship shook hard.
"There! The exit is this way!" she shouted.
Soon, rescue boats arrived and took everyone safely to shore.
why: 사람들이 소리 지르며 사방으로 뛰어다닐 때 아빠가 이 말을 했어요. 겁먹고 허둥대지 말고 차분하게 생각하라는 뜻이에요.
Dad said this while people were screaming and running in every direction. It means do not panic, and think clearly.

qs.q: How did Somin find the exit in the dark?
qs.qko: 소민이는 깜깜한 곳에서 어떻게 출구를 찾았나요?
opts: She looked for a small green light and found the way out.
Her dad carried her up to the deck.
A rescue boat turned on its lights.
evs: She remembered the green signs and looked for a small green light.
People screamed and ran in every direction.
"There! The exit is this way!" she shouted.
Soon, rescue boats arrived and took everyone safely to shore.
why: 소민이는 초록색 표지판을 떠올려 작은 초록 불빛을 찾았고, 곧 «출구는 이쪽이에요!» 하고 외쳤어요. 두 문장을 이으면 답이 나와요.
Somin remembered the green signs and looked for a small green light, and then she shouted, «The exit is this way!» Put these two sentences together to find the answer.

ends: Somin teaches her class how to stay safe on a ship.
소민이가 반 친구들에게 배에서 안전하게 지내는 법을 알려 줘요.
Somin and her dad finally visit the small island.
소민이와 아빠가 드디어 작은 섬에 놀러 가요.

write.src: “We should <u>learn where the exits are</u> so that <u>we can get out quickly</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «해야 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and its purpose in English.

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 할 수 있다» 를 쓰세요. (예: so that we can stay safe)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what they can do. (e.g. so that we can stay safe)

img.cover: In a dark, tilted ship hallway, an eleven-year-old Korean girl with two short black pigtails, a mint-green raincoat and white sneakers points toward a small glowing green light above a door with no writing on it, followed by her dad, a tall man with short black hair, a gray sweater and a small backpack, and then a line of people in orange life jackets.

scenes.1: Inside a ferry cabin with a little water on the floor, an eleven-year-old Korean girl with two short black pigtails, a mint-green raincoat and white sneakers kneels by the seats and helps a small boy put on an orange life jacket, while her dad, a tall man with short black hair, a gray sweater and a small backpack calmly holds out more life jackets and other passengers rush past behind them.
scenes.3: On the ship's deck under a cloudy sky, an eleven-year-old Korean girl with two short black pigtails, a mint-green raincoat and white sneakers and her dad, a tall man with short black hair, a gray sweater and a small backpack wave at orange rescue boats coming near, and the small boy in an orange life jacket holds her hand and smiles.
